name: services/blobbox/users_all
description: This method works like the users method, but it returns all users in whose name you store any data. Note, that the result might be very large.
brief_description: Get storage usage statistics for all users.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of fields (as in the consumer method).

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
Same as the the users method.

Note: Only users with all_count greater than zero will be included.
